title: 아버지 글씨
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B and Neo-Soul. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated jazz-influenced chords with light chorus and reverb. A smooth male tenor vocal alternates between a conversational chest voice and airy falsetto ad-libs. The bass guitar follows a melodic, walking pattern with a warm, rounded tone. Drums consist of a crisp snare and a tight, dry kick drum. The tempo is 92 BPM in 4/4 time. Occasional electric piano chords provide harmonic layering during transitions.
